title: Xp from Crops
description: Other living things give experience, why not crops? (∩ ･ｏ･)⊃
body:
# Xp from Crops Fully grown crops now drop experience!
Supported Crops - 1 xp - Sweet Berries - Glow Berries - 1-2 xp - Beetroot - Cocoa beans - 1-3 xp - Wheat - Potato - Carrot - Pumpkin/Melon stem - 2-4 xp - Nether Wart
## Compatibility I've only tested this with a few versions to check compatibility, so if you test it with any version please let me know on discord if it works or breaks! That way I can fix bugs and add more versions. Thank you so much! ## Issues [![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49eac7d4916630c1ca7a85fe90f40e2363ae80eb.png)](https://discord.gg/W3T34eVScQ) #### I dont plan on making Forge/NeoForge versions, if any mod devs would like to join my projects to work on these, please contact me on Discord!
